text_blocks.snippet: Treatment for duodenal diverticula depends on whether the condition is symptomatic or asymptomatic and if complications are present. Asymptomatic duodenal diverticula typically require no treatment, while symptomatic or complicated cases may need endoscopic or surgical intervention.
snippet_highlighted_words: Asymptomatic duodenal diverticula typically require no treatment, while symptomatic or complicated cases may need endoscopic or surgical intervention

list.snippet: Most duodenal diverticula are discovered incidentally during imaging for other conditions and are often asymptomatic.
In the absence of symptoms or complications, no treatment is typically required, according to a review from the National Institutes of Health (NIH).
